requirements.text: Ensure full compliance with PSD2 regulations, particularly around customer authentication for payments.
Adhere to GDPR requirements, especially regarding data storage and processing.
Prioritize features like real-time transaction notifications, user control over card functionalities, and spending insights, with a compliance assessment for each.
Implement strong customer authentication using multiple factors, including biometric options, while ensuring regulatory compliance.
Maintain a compliance-first approach when considering the impact of technical limitations related to the existing core banking system.
